```json
}
```

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;

namespace OpenLoop.App
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 下拉框被宽度裁切时，用 ToolTip 显示完整选项（Text + SubText）。
    /// 选中项变化时自动刷新。
    /// </summary>
    internal static class SelectTips
    {
        public static void Bind(ToolTip tips, params AntdUI.Select[] selects)
        {
            if (tips == null) return;
            foreach (var select in selects)
            {
                if (select == null) continue;
                var target = select;
                target.SelectedValueChanged += (_, _) => Refresh(tips, target);
                target.SelectedIndexChanged += (_, _) => Refresh(tips, target);
                Refresh(tips, target);
            }
        }

        private static void Refresh(ToolTip tips, AntdUI.Select select)
        {
            if (select.IsDisposed) return;
            tips.SetToolTip(select, Describe(select));
        }

        private static string Describe(AntdUI.Select select)
        {
            int index = select.SelectedIndex;
            if (index < 0 || index >= select.Items.Count) return "";
            if (select.Items[index] is not AntdUI.SelectItem item) return "";
            string text = item.Text ?? "";
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.SubText))
                text = text.Length == 0 ? item.SubText : text + Environment.NewLine + item.SubText;
            return text;
        }
    }
}
```

SelectTips implementation:

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;

namespace OpenLoop.App
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 下拉框宽度不足以显示完整选项时，用 ToolTip 补全（Text + SubText）。
    /// 选中项变化、鼠标进入时刷新。
    /// </summary>
    internal static class SelectTips
    {
        public static void Bind(ToolTip tips, params AntdUI.Select[] selects)
        {
            if (tips == null) return;
            foreach (var select in selects)
            {
                if (select == null) continue;
                var target = select;
                target.SelectedValueChanged += (_, _) => Refresh(tips, target);
                target.SelectedIndexChanged += (_, _) => Refresh(tips, target);
                target.MouseEnter += (_, _) => Refresh(tips, target);
                Refresh(tips, target);
            }
        }

        private static void Refresh(ToolTip tips, AntdUI.Select select)
        {
            if (tips == null || select == null || select.IsDisposed) return;
            tips.SetToolTip(select, Describe(select));
        }

        private static string Describe(AntdUI.Select select)
        {
            int index = select.SelectedIndex;
            if (index < 0 || index >= select.Items.Count) return "";
            if (select.Items[index] is not AntdUI.SelectItem item) return "";
            string text = item.Text ?? "";
            string sub = item.SubText ?? "";
            if (sub.Length == 0) return text;
            return text.Length == 0 ? sub : text + Environment.NewLine + sub;
        }
    }
}
```

```diff
Index: src\OpenLoop.App\SelectTips.cs
===================================================================
--- src\OpenLoop.App\SelectTips.cs	before
+++ src\OpenLoop.App\SelectTips.cs	after
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+namespace OpenLoop.App
+{
+    /// <summary>
+    /// 下拉框宽度不足以显示完整选项时，用 ToolTip 补全（Text + SubText）。
+    /// 选中项变化或鼠标移入时刷新。
+    /// </summary>
+    internal static class SelectTips
+    {
+        public static void Bind(ToolTip tips, params AntdUI.Select[] selects)
+        {
+            if (tips == null) return;
+            foreach (var select in selects)
+            {
+                if (select == null) continue;
+                var target = select;
+                target.SelectedValueChanged += (_, _) => Refresh(tips, target);
+                target.SelectedIndexChanged += (_, _) => Refresh(tips, target);
+                target.MouseEnter += (_, _) => Refresh(tips, target);
+                Refresh(tips, target);
+            }
+        }
+
+        private static void Refresh(ToolTip tips, AntdUI.Select select)
+        {
+            if (tips == null || select == null || select.IsDisposed) return;
+            tips.SetToolTip(select, Describe(select));
+        }
+
+        private static string Describe(AntdUI.Select select)
+        {
+            int index = select.SelectedIndex;
+            if (index < 0 || index >= select.Items.Count) return "";
+            if (select.Items[index] is not AntdUI.SelectItem item) return "";
+
+            string text = item.Text ?? "";
+            string sub = item.SubText ?? "";
+            if (sub.Length == 0) return text;
+            return text.Length == 0 ? sub : text + Environment.NewLine + sub;
+        }
+    }
+}
```

```csharp
    private readonly Timer timer = new() { Interval = 80 };
    private int angle;
    private Font font = new("Microsoft YaHei UI", 9F);

    public ChatThinkingRow()
    {
        SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint | ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer | ControlStyles.UserPaint | ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw, true);
        BackColor = Color.Transparent;
        TabStop = false;
        timer.Tick += (_, _) => { angle = (angle + 30) % 360; Invalidate(); };
    }

    private int S(float v) => ...
    public string Text { ... } // maybe use localized? "思考中…"

    public int Bind(int width)

        if (!timer.Enabled) timer.Start();

        return S(38);
    }

    protected override void OnVisibleChanged(EventArgs e) { ... start/stop timer }
```

```csharp
protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
{
    var g = e.Graphics;
    g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
    var palette = ChatTheme.Current;
    Color accent = palette?.Accent ?? Color.FromArgb(22, 119, 255);  // Does palette Accent exist? yes but host may set.
    Color fore = palette?.ForeDim ?? Color.FromArgb(0x5F,0x6E,0x7E);

    int padX = S(10);
    int icon = S(14);
    int gap = S(8);
    using var f = new Font("Microsoft YaHei UI", 9F);
    Size textSize = TextRenderer.MeasureText(g, Text, f, Size.Empty, TextFormatFlags.NoPadding);
    int w = padX*2 + icon + gap + textSize.Width;
    int h = S(28);
    int top = (Height - h)/2;
    var rect = new Rectangle(S(12), top, w, h);
    using (var path = Rounded(rect, S(14)))
    using (var fill = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(16, accent)))
        g.FillPath(fill, path);

    // spinner center
    int cx = rect.Left + padX + icon/2, cy = rect.Top + h/2;
    int r = icon/2 - S(1);
    using (var track = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(50, accent), Math.Max(1.5f, S(2))))
        g.DrawEllipse(track, cx-r, cy-r, r*2, r*2);
    using (var arc = new Pen(accent, Math.Max(1.5f, S(2))) { StartCap = LineCap.Round, EndCap = LineCap.Round })
        g.DrawArc(arc, cx-r, cy-r, r*2, r*2, angle, 110);
    TextRenderer.DrawText(g, Text, f, new Rectangle(rect.Left+padX+icon+gap, rect.Top, textSize.Width+2, h), fore, TextFormatFlags.VerticalCenter|TextFormatFlags.NoPadding);
}
```

Implementation:

```csharp
using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;

namespace ChatFlow
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 聊天末尾的「思考中…」指示行：旋转弧线 + 文案，执行期间常驻在最后一条消息之后。
    /// 动画由独立 Timer 驱动，仅本行 Invalidate，不触发整表重排。
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed class ChatThinkingRow : Control
    {
        internal const int RowHeightDip = 40;
        private const string IndicatorText = "思考中…";

        private readonly System.Windows.Forms.Timer spin = new() { Interval = 55 };
        private readonly Font font = new("Microsoft YaHei UI", 9F);
        private int angle;

        public ChatThinkingRow()
        {
            SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint
                | ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer
                | ControlStyles.UserPaint, true);
            BackColor = Color.Transparent;
            TabStop = false;
            spin.Tick += (_, _) => { angle = (angle + 30) % 360; Invalidate(); };
        }

        private int S(float value) => Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Round(value * DeviceDpi / 96f));

        /// <summary>绑定布局宽度：刷新底色与动画状态，返回行高（DIP 换算后的像素）。</summary>
        public int Bind(int width)
        {
            BackColor = ChatTheme.Current?.Back ?? Parent?.BackColor ?? Color.WhiteSmoke;
            if (Visible && !spin.Enabled) spin.Start();
            Invalidate();
            return S(RowHeightDip);
        }

        protected override void OnVisibleChanged(EventArgs e)
        {
            base.OnVisibleChanged(e);
            if (Visible) spin.Start();
            else spin.Stop();
        }

        protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
        {
            Color accent = ChatTheme.Current?.Accent ?? Color.FromArgb(0x16, 0x77, 0xFF);
            Color fore = ChatTheme.Current?.ForeDim ?? Color.FromArgb(0x5F, 0x6E, 0x7E);
            var g = e.Graphics;
            g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;

            int pad = S(10);
            int icon = S(14);
            int gap = S(8);
            Size text = TextRenderer.MeasureText(g, IndicatorText, font, Size.Empty, TextFormatFlags.NoPadding);
            int height = S(28);
            int width = pad * 2 + icon + gap + text.Width;
            int left = S(12);
            int top = Math.Max(0, (Height - height) / 2);

            using (var path = Rounded(new Rectangle(left, top, width, height), height / 2))
            using (var fill = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(16, accent)))
                g.FillPath(fill, path);

            int size = icon - S(2);
            int cx = left + pad + icon / 2;
            int cy = top + height / 2;
            var circle = new Rectangle(cx - size / 2, cy - size / 2, size, size);
            using (var track = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(48, accent), Math.Max(1.5f, S(1.5f))))
                g.DrawEllipse(track, circle);
            using (var arc = new Pen(accent, Math.Max(1.5f, S(1.5f))))
            {
                arc.StartCap = LineCap.Round;
                arc.EndCap = LineCap.Round;
                g.DrawArc(arc, circle, angle, 110);
            }

            TextRenderer.DrawText(g, IndicatorText, font,
                new Rectangle(left + pad + icon + gap, top, text.Width + 2, height), fore,
                TextFormatFlags.VerticalCenter | TextFormatFlags.NoPadding);
        }

        protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
        {
            if (disposing)
            {
                spin.Stop();
                spin.Dispose();
                font.Dispose();
            }
            base.Dispose(disposing);
        }

        private static GraphicsPath Rounded(Rectangle rect, int radius)
        {
            var path = new GraphicsPath();
            int d = Math.Max(1, Math.Min(radius * 2, Math.Min(rect.Width, rect.Height)));
            path.AddArc(rect.Left, rect.Top, d, d, 180, 90);
            path.AddArc(rect.Right - d, rect.Top, d, d, 270, 90);
            path.AddArc(rect.Right - d, rect.Bottom - d, d, d, 0, 90);
            path.AddArc(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - d, d, d, 90, 90);
            path.CloseFigure();
            return path;
        }
    }
}
```

Parent?.BackColor ?? Color.WhiteSmoke;\n            if (Visible && !spin.Enabled) spin.Start();\n            Invalidate();\n            return S(RowHeightDip);\n        }\n\n        protected override void OnVisibleChanged(EventArgs e)\n        {\n            base.OnVisibleChanged(e);\n            if (Visible) spin.Start();\n            else spin.Stop();\n        }\n\n        protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)\n        {\n            Color accent = ChatTheme.Current?.Accent ?? Color.FromArgb(0x16, 0x77, 0xFF);\n            Color fore = ChatTheme.Current?.ForeDim ?? Color.FromArgb(0x5F, 0x6E, 0x7E);\n            var g = e.Graphics;\n            g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;\n\n            int pad = S(10);\n            int icon = S(14);\n            int gap = S(8);\n            Size text = TextRenderer.MeasureText(g, IndicatorText, font, Size.Empty, TextFormatFlags.NoPadding);\n            int pillHeight = S(28);\n            int pillWidth = pad * 2 + icon + gap + text.Width;\n            int left = S(12);\n            int top = Math.Max(0, (Height - pillHeight) / 2);\n\n            // 淡色胶囊底：让指示条在深浅主题上都不会“浮”在正文里\n            using (var path = Rounded(new Rectangle(left, top, pillWidth, pillHeight), pillHeight / 2))\n            using (var fill = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(16, accent)))\n                g.FillPath(fill, path);\n\n            // 旋转弧线：浅色轨道 + 加粗高亮弧，弧端圆头\n            int size = icon - S(2);\n            int cx = left + pad + icon / 2;\n            int cy = top + pillHeight / 2;\n            var circle = new Rectangle(cx - size / 2, cy - size / 2, size, size);\n            float stroke = Math.Max(1.5f, S(1.5f));\n            using (var track = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(48, accent), stroke))\n                g.DrawEllipse(track, circle);\n            using (var arc = new Pen(accent, stroke))\n            {\n                arc.StartCap = LineCap.Round;\n                arc.EndCap = LineCap.Round;\n                g.DrawArc(arc, circle, angle, 110);\n            }\n\n            TextRenderer.DrawText(g, IndicatorText, font,\n                new Rectangle(left + pad + icon + gap, top, text.Width + 2, pillHeight), fore,\n                TextFormatFlags.VerticalCenter | TextFormatFlags.NoPadding);\n        }\n\n        protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)\n        {\n            if (disposing)\n            {\n                spin.Stop();\n                spin.Dispose();\n                font.Dispose();\n            }\n            base.Dispose(disposing);\n        }\n\n        private static GraphicsPath Rounded(Rectangle rect, int radius)\n        {\n            var path = new GraphicsPath();\n            int d = Math.Max(1, Math.Min(radius * 2, Math.Min(rect.Width, rect.Height)));\n            path.AddArc(rect.Left, rect.Top, d, d, 180, 90);\n            path.AddArc(rect.Right - d, rect.Top, d, d, 270, 90);\n            path.AddArc(rect.Right - d, rect.Bottom - d, d, d, 0, 90);\n            path.AddArc(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - d, d, d, 90, 90);\n            path.CloseFigure();\n            return path;\n        }\n    }\n}\n"

```
+﻿using FastColoredTextBoxNS.Feature;
+using FastColoredTextBoxNS.Text;
+using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;
+
+namespace FastColoredTextBoxNS.Types
+{
+    /// <summary>
+    /// Style of chars
+    /// </summary>
+    /// <remarks>This is base class for all text and design renderers</remarks>
+    public abstract class Style : IDisposable
+    {
+        /// <summary>
+        /// This style is exported to outer formats (HTML for example)
+        /// </summary>
+        public virtual bool IsExportable { get; set; }
+        /// <summary>
+        /// Occurs when user click on StyleVisualMarker joined to this style
+        /// </summary>
+        public event EventHandler<VisualMarkerEventArgs> VisualMarkerClick;
+
+        /// <summary>
+        /// Constructor
+        /// </summary>
+        public Style() => IsExportable = true;
+
+        /// <summary>
+        /// Renders given range of text
+        /// </summary>
+        /// <param name="gr">Graphics object</param>
+        /// <param name="position">Position of the range in absolute control coordinates</param>
+        /// <param name="range">Rendering range of text</param>
+        public abstract void Draw(Graphics gr, Point position, TextSelectionRange range);
+
+        /// <summary>
+        /// Occurs when user click on StyleVisualMarker joined to this style
+        /// </summary>
+        public virtual void OnVisualMarkerClick(FastColoredTextBox tb, VisualMarkerEventArgs args) => VisualMarkerClick?.Invoke(tb, args);
+
+        /// <summary>
+        /// Shows VisualMarker
+        /// Call this method in Draw method, when you need to show VisualMarker for your style
+        /// </summary>
+        protected virtual void AddVisualMarker(FastColoredTextBox tb, StyleVisualMarker marker) => tb.AddVisualMarker(marker);
+        public static Size GetSizeOfRange(TextSelectionRange range)
+        {
+            //Original implementation: => new((range.End.iChar - range.Start.iChar) * range.tb.CharWidth, range.tb.CharHeight);
+            int rangeWidth = 0;
+            foreach (char c in range.Text) rangeWidth += range.tb.GetCharWidth(c);
+
+            return new(rangeWidth, range.tb.CharHeight);
+        }
+
+        public static GraphicsPath GetRoundedRectangle(Rectangle rect, int d)
+        {
+            GraphicsPath gp = new();
+
+            gp.AddArc(rect.X, rect.Y, d, d, 180, 90);
+            gp.AddArc(rect.X + rect.Width - d, rect.Y, d, d, 270, 90);
+            gp.AddArc(rect.X + rect.Width - d, rect.Y + rect.Height - d, d, d, 0, 90);
+            gp.AddArc(rect.X, rect.Y + rect.Height - d, d, d, 90, 90);
+            gp.AddLine(rect.X, rect.Y + rect.Height - d, rect.X, rect.Y + d / 2);
+
+            return gp;
+        }
+
+        public virtual void Dispose()
+        {
+            GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
+        }
+
+        /// <summary>
+        /// Returns CSS for export to HTML
+        /// </summary>
+        /// <returns></returns>
+        public virtual string GetCSS() => "";
+
+        /// <summary>
+        /// Returns RTF descriptor for export to RTF
+        /// </summary>
+        /// <returns></returns>
+        public virtual RTFStyleDescriptor GetRTF() => new();
+    }
+
+    /// <summary>
+    /// Style for chars rendering
+    /// This renderer can draws chars, with defined fore and back colors
+    /// </summary>
+    public class TextStyle : Style
+    {
+        public Brush ForeBrush { get; set; }
+        public Brush BackgroundBrush { get; set; }
+        public FontStyle FontStyle { get; set; }
+        //public readonly Font Font;
+        public StringFormat stringFormat;
+
+        public TextStyle(Brush foreBrush, Brush backgroundBrush, FontStyle fontStyle)
+        {
+            ForeBrush = foreBrush;
+            BackgroundBrush = backgroundBrush;
+            FontStyle = fontStyle;
+            stringFormat = new StringFormat(StringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces);
+        }
+
+        public static System.Text.StringBuilder Trace;
+
+        public override void Draw(Graphics gr, Point position, TextSelectionRange range)
+        {
+            Trace?.AppendLine($"TextStyle.Draw bg={BackgroundBrush != null} pos={position} chars=[{range.Start.iChar},{range.End.iChar}) text='{range.Text}' tf={gr.Transform.Elements[0]}/{gr.Transform.Elements[3]} hint={gr.TextRenderingHint}");
+            //draw background
+            if (BackgroundBrush != null)
+            {
+                //Old implementaiton: var rangeWidth=(range.End.iChar - range.Start.iChar) * range.tb.CharWidth 
+                gr.FillRectangle(BackgroundBrush, position.X - (int)(range.tb.CharWidth * 0.10), position.Y, GetSizeOfRange(range).Width + (int)(range.tb.CharWidth * 0.20), range.tb.CharHeight);
+            }
+            //draw chars
+            using var f = new Font(range.tb.Font, FontStyle);
+            Line line = range.tb[range.Start.iLine];
+
+            float y = position.Y + range.tb.LineInterval / 2;
+            float x = position.X;
+            var renderText = true;
+
+            ForeBrush ??= new SolidBrush(range.tb.ForeColor);
+            float dx = 0;  //dx is not a fixed value for CJK chars
+            if (range.tb.ImeAllowed)
+            {
+                //IME mode
+                for (int i = range.Start.iChar; i < range.End.iChar; i++)
+                {
+                    // Paint the text using the foreground brush for a half second
+                    // and use the background the other half, to achieve a blink
+                    // Our blink render task will handle the rest.
+                    if (line[i].Blinking && range.tb.EnableBlinkingStyle)
+                        renderText = DateTime.Now.Second % 2 == 0;
+                    else
+                        renderText = true;
+
+                    if (renderText)
+                    {
+                        char real = line[i].C;
+                        var c = Masked(real, range.tb);
+                        SizeF size = FastColoredTextBox.GetCharSize(f, c);
+                        //advance by the real char so the caret/selection geometry (measured from the
+                        //unmasked text) stays aligned
+                        dx = range.tb.GetCharWidth(real);
+
+                        var gs = gr.Save();
+                        float k = size.Width > range.tb.GetCharWidth(c) + 1 ? range.tb.GetCharWidth(c) / size.Width : 1;
+                        gr.TranslateTransform(x, y + (1 - k) * range.tb.CharHeight / 2);
+                        gr.ScaleTransform(k, (float)Math.Sqrt(k));
+                        gr.DrawString(c.ToString(), f, ForeBrush, 0, 0, stringFormat);
+                        gr.Restore(gs);
+                        x += dx;
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            else
+            {
+                //classic mode
+                for (int i = range.Start.iChar; i < range.End.iChar; i++)
+                {
+                    // Paint the text using the foreground brush for a half second
+                    // and use the background the other half, to achieve a blink
+                    // Our blink render task will handle the rest.
+                    if (line[i].Blinking && range.tb.EnableBlinkingStyle)
+                        renderText = DateTime.Now.Second % 2 == 0;
+                    else
+                        renderText = true;
+
+                    if (renderText)
+                    {
+                        //draw char
+                        gr.DrawString(Masked(line[i].C, range.tb).ToString(), f, ForeBrush, x, y, stringFormat);
+                        //advance by the actual char width (dx is only set in the IME branch;
+                        //leaving it 0 here stacked every char of the run on the same x)
+                        x += range.tb.GetCharWidth(line[i].C);
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        /// <summary>
+        /// Applies <see cref="FastColoredTextBox.PasswordChar"/> to a char before it is rendered.
+        /// </summary>
+        private static char Masked(char c, FastColoredTextBox tb) => tb.PasswordChar == '\0' ? c : tb.PasswordChar;
+
+        public override string GetCSS()
+        {
+            string result = "";
+
+            if (BackgroundBrush is SolidBrush)
+            {
+                var s = ExportToHTML.GetColorAsString((BackgroundBrush as SolidBrush).Color);
+                if (s != "")
+                    result += "background-color:" + s + ";";
+            }
+            if (ForeBrush is SolidBrush)
+            {
+                var s = ExportToHTML.GetColorAsString((ForeBrush as SolidBrush).Color);
+                if (s != "")
+                    result += "color:" + s + ";";
+            }
+            if ((FontStyle & FontStyle.Bold) != 0)
+                result += "font-weight:bold;";
+            if ((FontStyle & FontStyle.Italic) != 0)
+                result += "font-style:oblique;";
+            if ((FontStyle & FontStyle.Strikeout) != 0)
+                result += "text-decoration:line-through;";
+            if ((FontStyle & FontStyle.Underline) != 0)
+                result += "text-decoration:underline;";
+
+            return result;
+        }
+
+        public override RTFStyleDescriptor GetRTF()
+        {
+            var result = new RTFStyleDescriptor();
+
+            if (BackgroundBrush is SolidBrush)
+                result.BackColor = (BackgroundBrush as SolidBrush).Color;
+
+            if (ForeBrush is SolidBrush)
+                result.ForeColor = (ForeBrush as SolidBrush).Color;
+
+            if ((FontStyle & FontStyle.Bold) != 0)
+                result.AdditionalTags += @"\b";
+            if ((FontStyle & FontStyle.Italic) != 0)
+                result.AdditionalTags += @"\i";
+            if ((FontStyle & FontStyle.Strikeout) != 0)
+                result.AdditionalTags += @"\strike";
+            if ((FontStyle & FontStyle.Underline) != 0)
+                result.AdditionalTags += @"\ul";
+
+            return result;
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// <summary>
+    /// Renderer for folded block
+    /// </summary>
+    public class FoldedBlockStyle : TextStyle
+    {
+        public FoldedBlockStyle(Brush foreBrush, Brush backgroundBrush, FontStyle fontStyle) :
+            base(foreBrush, backgroundBrush, fontStyle)
+        {
+        }
+
+        public override void Draw(Graphics gr, Point position, TextSelectionRange range)
+        {
+            if (range.End.iChar > range.Start.iChar)
+            {
+                base.Draw(gr, position, range);
+
+                int firstNonSpaceSymbolX = position.X;
+
+                //find first non space symbol
+                //use per-char width (CJK/mixed text): a fixed CharWidth misplaces the box for
+                //narrow leading spaces, leaving the folded line's text outside the marker.
+                for (int i = range.Start.iChar; i < range.End.iChar; i++)
+                {
+                    char c = range.tb[range.Start.iLine][i].C;
+                    if (c != ' ')
+                        break;
+                    firstNonSpaceSymbolX += range.tb.GetCharWidth(c);
+                }
+
+                //create marker (actual range width, not chars * fixed CharWidth)
+                range.tb.AddVisualMarker(new FoldedAreaMarker(range.Start.iLine, new Rectangle(firstNonSpaceSymbolX, position.Y, position.X + GetSizeOfRange(range).Width - firstNonSpaceSymbolX, range.tb.CharHeight)));
+            }
+            else
+            {
+                //draw '...'
+                using (Font f = new(range.tb.Font, FontStyle))
+                    gr.DrawString("...", f, ForeBrush, range.tb.LeftIndent, position.Y - 2);
+                //create marker
+                range.tb.AddVisualMarker(new FoldedAreaMarker(range.Start.iLine, new Rectangle(range.tb.LeftIndent + 2, position.Y, 2 * range.tb.CharHeight, range.tb.CharHeight)));
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// <summary>
+    /// Renderer for selected area
+    /// </summary>
+    public class SelectionStyle : Style
+    {
+        public Brush BackgroundBrush { get; set; }
+        public Brush ForegroundBrush { get; private set; }
+
+        public override bool IsExportable
+        {
+            get { return false; }
+            set { }
+        }
+
+        public SelectionStyle(Brush backgroundBrush, Brush foregroundBrush = null)
+        {
+            BackgroundBrush = backgroundBrush;
+            ForegroundBrush = foregroundBrush;
+        }
+
+        public override void Draw(Graphics gr, Point position, TextSelectionRange range)
+        {
+            //draw background
+            if (BackgroundBrush != null)
+            {
+                var rangeSize = GetSizeOfRange(range);
+                if (rangeSize.Width == 0) return;
+                gr.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.None;
+                var rect = new Rectangle(position.X, position.Y, rangeSize.Width, rangeSize.Height);
+
+                gr.FillRectangle(BackgroundBrush, rect);
+                //
+                if (ForegroundBrush != null)
+                {
+                    //draw text
+                    gr.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
+
+                    var r = new TextSelectionRange(range.tb, range.Start.iChar, range.Start.iLine,
+                                      Math.Min(range.tb[range.End.iLine].Count, range.End.iChar), range.End.iLine);
+                    using var style = new TextStyle(ForegroundBrush, null, FontStyle.Regular);
+                    style.Draw(gr, new Point(position.X, position.Y - 1), r);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// <summary>
+    /// Marker style
+    /// Draws background color for text
+    /// </summary>
+    public class MarkerStyle : Style
+    {
+        public Brush BackgroundBrush { get; set; }
+
+        public MarkerStyle(Brush backgroundBrush)
+        {
+            BackgroundBrush = backgroundBrush;
+            IsExportable = true;
+        }
+
+        public override void Draw(Graphics gr, Point position, TextSelectionRange range)
+        {
+            //draw background
+            if (BackgroundBrush != null)
+            {
+                Rectangle rect = new(position.X, position.Y, (range.End.iChar - range.Start.iChar) * range.tb.CharWidth, range.tb.CharHeight);
+                if (rect.Width == 0)
+                    return;
+                gr.FillRectangle(BackgroundBrush, rect);
+            }
+        }
+
+        public override string GetCSS()
+        {
+            string result = "";
+
+            if (BackgroundBrush is SolidBrush)
+            {
+                var s = ExportToHTML.GetColorAsString((BackgroundBrush as SolidBrush).Color);
+                if (s != "")
+                    result += "background-color:" + s + ";";
+            }
+
+            return result;
+        }

+    /// <summary>
```

Confirmed dramatically: at 240 DPI the glyph is inset 7-8px into a cell of width 8-29px, and its ink extends past the cell's right edge (e.g. 'l': cell 20..28, ink 27..30). Every glyph therefore overflows into the next cell, where the next char's background fill paints over it → the garbled look in the screenshot.

Root cause: `TextStyle.stringFormat = new StringFormat(StringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces)` — GDI+ non-typographic layout adds ~1/6 em padding on the left of the draw origin (7-8px at 240 DPI), while cells advance by GDI/typographic width.

Fix: use a typographic StringFormat for glyph drawing (no layout padding) so each glyph starts at its cell's left edge.

```csharp
[Fact]
public void CreatingHandleOnMtaThread_DoesNotThrow()

        try {
            using var tb = new FastColoredTextBox();
            _ = tb.Handle;   // Control.OnHandleCreated registers the OLE drop target

    });

    t.Start(); t.Join();
    if (failure != null) throw failure;
}
```

```csharp
public override bool AllowDrop
{
    get => base.AllowDrop;
    set
    {
        // OLE drop targets need an STA thread; assigning off-STA throws ThreadStateException
        // from Control.SetAcceptDrops even when the host only inherits the default.
        if (value && System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.GetApartmentState() != ApartmentState.STA)
            return;
        base.AllowDrop = value;
    }
}
```

修好了两件事，都在 FCTB 源码里，ChatFlow/OpenLoop 不用改代码（它们已经通过条件引用直接吃 FCTB 源码）。

**1. 行内代码里的拉丁字符乱码（你截图那个）**

根因确认：`TextStyle` 逐字符绘制时用的是普通 `StringFormat`（非 typographic），GDI+ 会给每段文本加约 1/6 em 的排版内边距，把字形整体右移——250% DPI 下就是 7~8px，而单元格宽度是按 GDI 字宽（`GetCharWidth`）推进的。窄字符的字形因此溢出到下一个字符的单元格里，被那个字符的**背景色块**覆盖掉右半边，所以只有带背景的文本（行内代码、代码块、表格）会花，普通文字看不出来。

修复：`TextStyle` 的绘制格式改为 `StringFormat.GenericTypographic`（无内边距，字形落在请求的原点，正好对上 `GetCharWidth` 的推进量）。我用真实 240 DPI 的行渲染复现了你的截图（修复前 `cc(s/(cc€-1€v €v-5tmm€1y mC`、`Ficc€ss`，修复后完全正常），改完已看不到残缺字形。

**2. DragDrop 注册失败**

根因：`FastColoredTextBox` 构造时 `AllowDrop = true`，WinForms 在句柄创建时（`Control.OnHandleCreated` → `SetAcceptDrops`）注册 OLE 拖放目标，而 OLE 要求 STA 线程；句柄一旦在 MTA 线程上创建就抛 `ThreadStateException`。这是 FCTB 自身太脆，不怪调用方写了什么。

修复两处：句柄创建时若当前线程不是 STA 就跳过注册（`OnHandleCreated`）；句柄已存在时在 MTA 线程上设 `AllowDrop = true` 直接忽略而不是抛。新加的回归测试在旧代码上**必现**你那条异常，改后通过——说明修复的是同一个问题。若你那边还看到这条报错，那一定是旧二进制，请重新 build 一次。

```json
{
```

```csharp
    public int Calls { get; private set; }

    public Task<CompletionResult> CompleteAsync(...) { Calls++; return Task.FromResult(new CompletionResult { Content = "", Reasoning = _reasoning }); }
}
```
